name: Brachygnathosuchus
isnote: Only 'crocodilian' is supported by the sources consulted; no finer placement is given.
sum: Brachygnathosuchus is a crocodilian known from partial remains found in the Upper Purus River region of western Brazil.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Remains from the Upper Purus River, western Brazil, found in river silt (Mook 1921); Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Partial remains and an eroded osteoderm.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Mook 1921

sources.text: C. C. Mook. 1921. Brachygnathosuchus braziliensis, a new fossil crocodilian from Brazil. Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History 44:43-49
